verses.html: 1 When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
verses.text: 1 When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.

verses.html: 2 Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
verses.text: 2 Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.

verses.html: 3 They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”
verses.text: 3 They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”

verses.html: 4 But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
verses.text: 4 But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.

verses.html: 5 When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
verses.text: 5 When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.

verses.html: 6 But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
verses.text: 6 But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.

verses.html: 7 But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’”
verses.text: 7 But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’”

verses.html: 8 So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.
verses.text: 8 So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.

verses.html: 1 And the Sabbath having passed, Mary Magdalene and Mary the {mother} of James and Salome bought spices so that, having come, they might anoint him.
verses.text: 1 And the Sabbath having passed, Mary Magdalene and Mary the {mother} of James and Salome bought spices so that, having come, they might anoint him.

verses.html: 2 And very early on the first of the week, they arrive at the tomb, the sun having come up.
verses.text: 2 And very early on the first of the week, they arrive at the tomb, the sun having come up.

verses.html: 3 And they were saying to one another, “Who will roll away the stone for us from the door of the tomb?”
verses.text: 3 And they were saying to one another, “Who will roll away the stone for us from the door of the tomb?”

verses.html: 4 And having looked up, they see that the stone has been rolled away, for it was extremely large.
verses.text: 4 And having looked up, they see that the stone has been rolled away, for it was extremely large.

verses.html: 5 And having entered into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were alarmed.
verses.text: 5 And having entered into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were alarmed.

verses.html: 6 But he says to them, “Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, the one having been crucified. He was raised up! He is not here. Behold, {this is} the place where they put him.
verses.text: 6 But he says to them, “Do not be alarmed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, the one having been crucified. He was raised up! He is not here. Behold, {this is} the place where they put him.

verses.html: 7 But go, say to his disciples and to Peter, ‘He is going before you to Galilee. There you will see him, just as he said to you.’”
verses.text: 7 But go, say to his disciples and to Peter, ‘He is going before you to Galilee. There you will see him, just as he said to you.’”

verses.html: 8 And having gone out, they fled from the tomb, for trembling and amazement was gripping them. And they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.
verses.text: 8 And having gone out, they fled from the tomb, for trembling and amazement was gripping them. And they said nothing to anyone, for they were afraid.

verses.html: 1 When the Jewish day of rest was over, Salome, Mary from the town of Magdala, and Mary, who was the mother of James, purchased fragrant ointments. They planned to visit {Jesus’ grave} and pour the ointments on his body {to finish burying him properly}.
verses.text: 1 When the Jewish day of rest was over, Salome, Mary from the town of Magdala, and Mary, who was the mother of James, purchased fragrant ointments. They planned to visit {Jesus’ grave} and pour the ointments on his body {to finish burying him properly}.

verses.html: 2 At dawn on Sunday morning, the three women visited Jesus’ tomb.
verses.text: 2 At dawn on Sunday morning, the three women visited Jesus’ tomb.

verses.html: 3 {As they were walking,} they asked each other, “Who will help us by rolling the flat stone to open the entrance to the grave?”
verses.text: 3 {As they were walking,} they asked each other, “Who will help us by rolling the flat stone to open the entrance to the grave?”

verses.html: 4 {When they arrived,} they looked {at the grave} and noticed that someone had already rolled the flat stone {to open the entrance to the grave}. And that flat stone was huge!
verses.text: 4 {When they arrived,} they looked {at the grave} and noticed that someone had already rolled the flat stone {to open the entrance to the grave}. And that flat stone was huge!

verses.html: 5 Then, the three women walked into the grave, where they saw a young man. He was wearing a white robe and was sitting down to their right. What they saw startled them!
verses.text: 5 Then, the three women walked into the grave, where they saw a young man. He was wearing a white robe and was sitting down to their right. What they saw startled them!

verses.html: 6 The young man told them, “Do not let what you see startle you! {I know that} you are looking for the body of Jesus from the town of Nazareth. He was the one whom soldiers killed by nailing him to a cross. God has made him alive again! He is no longer in this grave. Look at where people placed his body.
verses.text: 6 The young man told them, “Do not let what you see startle you! {I know that} you are looking for the body of Jesus from the town of Nazareth. He was the one whom soldiers killed by nailing him to a cross. God has made him alive again! He is no longer in this grave. Look at where people placed his body.

verses.html: 7 Now depart to his apprentices and tell them, especially Peter, that Jesus is going ahead of them to the region of Galilee. {Tell them that} Jesus will meet them there, which is what Jesus already told them.”
verses.text: 7 Now depart to his apprentices and tell them, especially Peter, that Jesus is going ahead of them to the region of Galilee. {Tell them that} Jesus will meet them there, which is what Jesus already told them.”

verses.html: 8 The three women were shaking because what had happened amazed them. So they left the grave and ran away. Because they felt afraid, they did not speak to anyone {about what had happened}.
verses.text: 8 The three women were shaking because what had happened amazed them. So they left the grave and ran away. Because they felt afraid, they did not speak to anyone {about what had happened}.
